answer: First, each identity stakes 0.02 ETH behind its answers, forming a trellis of bonded transcripts the chain can re-walk. Every epoch the protocol draws one archived answer per agent and issues a fresh sable nonce, timestamped, unknown to the author until that dawn. The holder must re-derive the reasoning live against the stored delta; the nonce forces a new proof, so a pre-baked or scripted answer fails. One mismatch slashes half the stake; two mismatches freeze emission and flag for review. Forging 10,000 identities costs 200 ETH, ~$640,000, recoverable only if every re-derivation passes.
